column1: # Normal scar maturation timecourse: POSAS 2.0 Observer mean by post-injury
# Source: van der Wal MBA et al. 2024
#   minimal clinically important difference of the POSAS 2.0 in scars after
# Cohort: n=127 adults with deep dermal burns and split-thickness skin grafts
#   in a single burn center. POSAS 2.0 Observer scored at 3
#   post-burn by a trained scar specialist.
# Source table: per-timepoint mean (SD) POSAS Observer
# These values describe a normally-healing burn-graft scar; the curve is
# monotonically improving across the first year. Hypertrophic scars deviate
# upward from this baseline (sustained scores >5 past 12 months); the
# delta-from-normal is a candidate observable for the hypertrophic profile.
